originality.rationale: The precise new statement is the fixed-angle, all-collision pre-reset entanglement classification: sharp polarization threshold, exact finite number of entangling collisions, no delayed onset or revival, and logarithmic pure-bath divergence. The 2026 experiment already treats the same protocol, population recursion and early negativity plots; Scarani et al. give the locally equivalent partial-swap map and entangling power; de Oliveira Junior et al. give general one-stroke athermality entangleability conditions. Those published elements are fully credited, not recast as new. Inspected main text and supplements contain no explicit trajectory classification. value.rationale: The motivator observes disappearing system--ancilla entanglement in an experimentally implemented anti-thermalization protocol. The derived exact index set resolves precisely when that effect can occur at all, how long it lasts at fixed angle and reservoir polarization, and why it cannot return, identifying a universal polarization/temperature limit and singular pure-bath logarithmic lifetime. These are motivated all-parameter boundaries for the natural measured observable, rather than an arbitrary finite table; neither a downstream application nor a sweeping new theory is claimed.
